stem_book: Passage: If the central atom is of third row or below this in the periodic table, then lone pair will occupy a stereochemically inactive s-orbital and bonding will be through almost pure p-orbitals and bond angles are nearly 90°, if the substituent's electronegativity value is ≤ 2.5. (i) In which of the following option, covalent bond is having maximum s% character? (a) S—H bond in H₂S (b) P—H bond in PH₃ (c) N—H bond in NH₃ (d) All have equal s% character. (ii) Select incorrect statement regarding P₄ molecule. (a) Each P atom is joined with three P-atoms (b) P₄ molecule contains total 12 bond angles (c) Lone pair of each P atom is present in almost pure s-orbital (d) Lone pair of each P atom present in hybrid orbital. (iii) The hybridization of atomic orbitals of central atom 'Xe' in XeO₄, XeO₂F₂ and XeOF₄ respectively: (a) sp³, sp³d², sp³d² (b) sp³d, sp³d, sp³d² (c) sp³, sp³d², sp³d (d) sp³, sp³d, sp³d²
reason: Three-part passage with separate answers; the manifest lists its three parts as three entries under this one code — all three verified correct.
work: (i) N—H in NH₃ is sp³ (~25% s), S—H/P—H almost pure p; (ii) P₄ lone pair in near-pure s (Drago) so (d) false; 4×3 = 12 angles of 60°; (iii) XeO₄ 4 bp sp³, XeO₂F₂ 4 bp + 1 lp sp³d, XeOF₄ 5 bp + 1 lp sp³d²
